feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag gumawa ng bulag na paghugot sa bibig. Humingi muna ng tulong.
feedback_by_option.en: Do not use blind finger sweeps. Call for help first.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi ito mabisang ubo: hindi siya makapagsalita o makaubo nang mabisa. Humingi agad ng tulong.
feedback_by_option.en: This is not a mild cough: the adult cannot speak or cough effectively. Call for help now.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Humingi ng tulong, saka sundin ang kasalukuyang training ayon sa edad.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. Call for help, then follow current training for the person's age.

feedback_by_option.fil: Tama. Infant manikin at infant pathway na aprubado ng trainer ang para sa card ng sanggol.
feedback_by_option.en: Correct. The infant card needs the infant manikin and the trainer-approved infant pathway.

feedback_by_option.fil: Hindi para sa sanggol ang adult abdominal thrust. Lumipat sa infant pathway.
feedback_by_option.en: Adult abdominal thrusts are not for infants. Switch to the infant pathway.

feedback_by_option.fil: Huwag kailanman magsanay ng thrust sa totoong kapareha, kahit marahan. Manikin lamang.
feedback_by_option.en: Never rehearse thrusts on a live partner, even gently. Use manikins only.
